column1: # Release size budget: the ONE source of truth (slot 353 size-budget-gateway-fix,
# 2026-10-28 CET +01:00). Read by scripts/size-budget.sh (and through it by
# scripts/ucpu-gate.sh, scripts/self-check.sh and CI) and by the Rust tests
# Format: <binary> <TAB or spaces> <max bytes>. A binary fails when its size is
# strictly greater than its row. `default` applies to every ELF executable
# without its own row. Release artifact names carry a commit tag
# gaia-cortex-77df80f-llm); the tag is stripped before the lookup.
# Policy (checked by size_budget_gate.rs): default is 200 MB (209715200 B,
# 200 * 1024 * 1024) and no row may be above it. Owner decision t416u
# size is no longer a constraint when picking crates. A row above 200 MB needs
# an owner decision. Rows below 200 MB are allowed (a tighter budget).
